pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/24427

These should work now that our build pools have VS 16.8
pr_comments:
We're actually working on moving these tests out into the dotnet/sdk repo. It looks like the Helix machines are running VS 16.8.2 so it should be fine to re-enable the tests after migrating.

These tests will eventually be removed from this repo so I'll leave it up to you to determine whether the Razor SDK tests should be touched.
Talked with @captainsafia offline about this and we agreed it's ok to go ahead with merging this.

issue_context.title: Re-enable tests requiring 16.8 Visual Studio
issue_context.body: `Build_Components_WithDesktopMSBuild_Works`, `Build_SimpleMvc_WithServer_UsingDesktopMSBuild_CanBuildSuccessfully`, and `Build_SimpleMvc_UsingDesktopMSBuildAndWithoutBuildServer_CanBuildSuccessfully` fail without 16.8 VS's version of desktop MSBuild. We should re-enable those tests once we move to those queues. Also IntrospectRazorTasksDllPath_DesktopMsBuild
